images.name: 余烬·截锋
images.design: Crimson SHEAR one-handed sword. Asymmetric compact forward-weighted single-edged angular blade, lower blade narrow and straight, upper half widens sharply into a long forward-sloping broad cutting wedge ending in a hooked angular clip point. A SINGLE deep oblique V-notch cut into the upper spine, far from cutting edge, makes a memorable negative-space silhouette. Smooth uninterrupted sharpened left cutting edge, no saw teeth, no ladder terraces, no round holes. Blade face has one raised shallow diagonal facet ridge, broad clean ruby planes with vermilion/coral luminous bevels. Short guard made of TWO unequal triangular prongs facing diagonally forward, one longer on spine side; guard neck an off-center trapezoid, short straight single-hand grip and tiny faceted wedge pommel. Sparse tiny red diamond cinders near the V-notch. Practical sword length, strong and compact, vivid angular assassin-knight aesthetic.

images.name: 流萤·游梭
images.design: Emerald-to-mint SHUTTLE one-handed sword. A sleek continuous S-recurve blade with elegant leaf-lance silhouette: narrow root, broad flowing middle, upper third subtly curves back in opposite direction to a fine pointed tip. This is a solid blade, not a sickle or full crescent. A long narrow tapered spindle-shaped through-slot lies off-center in the LOWER half; preserve thick material around it and one continuous cutting edge. Outer edge turquoise green, rich jade broad faces, inset mint bevels. Guard is a compact single swept arch protecting the front knuckles, connects root collar to small lower grip collar like a stylish geometric D-guard, but leaves generous real hand space. Short straight one-palm grip, flattened oval pommel. A few tiny mint lozenge sparks near the spindle slot. Smooth aerodynamic surfaces and restrained flowing lines, no feather fins, no serrations, no vine textures, no ornamented metal.

images.name: 寒汐·棱隙
images.design: Blue-to-cyan APERTURE one-handed arming sword. A clean symmetrical broad double-edged blade with a long sharp spear point; its LOWER third opens into ONE large sharply elongated triangular aperture with tip upward, cut THROUGH the blade. Two thick angular side shoulders flank the triangular opening then merge into a solid uninterrupted upper blade; upper half has no holes. In the aperture levitates ONE small offset thin cyan triangle, physically separate, with ample empty space around it. Avoid a long rectangular window or ladder. Distinct guard formed by a low horizontal hexagonal block with two short downward-inclined chisel quillons, an angular architectural silhouette; short single-palm navy grip, flattened hexagonal pommel. Deep ocean blue solid planes, turquoise and cyan luminous bevels, a few tiny hollow triangle motes clustered within lower aperture. Balanced substantial geometry, not wireframe, no ice crystals, no engraved circuitry.

images.name: 梦隙·错影
images.design: Violet-to-lavender PARALLAX one-handed sword. The blade is built from exactly TWO broad straight blade plates staggered both sideways and in depth, creating an asymmetric stepped silhouette: the LEFT plate rises continuously from hilt to a very long acute diagonal main tip, the RIGHT plate starts higher above guard and ends lower than main point, its tip a shorter oblique chisel. Plates overlap for most of length, are close enough to read as ONE coherent single sword, with a thin dark seam between them; two short thick transverse geometric bridges connect them at lower third and upper-middle. Real 3D offset of slabs visible at three-quarter angle, not a fork, not twisted ribbons, not floating shattered pieces. Guard is a compact diagonal flattened rhomboid disc tilted in depth, pierced only by the short straight one-handed grip. Small skewed cuboid pommel. Deep blue-violet body faces alternating lavender bevels and subtle magenta-violet accent at bridges. Several tiny rectangular violet motes drift parallel to the offset seam. Minimal architectural and spatial illusion aesthetic.
